left.title: Trump And Putin To Hold Summit In Helsinki
left.body: President Donald Trump and his Russian counterpart, Vladimir Putin, will meet July 16 in Helsinki in a one-on-one summit meeting, the White House announced Thursday. The meeting will be the first of its kind between the leaders.
left.roundup: Russian President Vladimir Putin and U.S. President Donald Trump will hold a summit in Helsinki on July 16, the Kremlin and the White House announced Thursday.

center.title: Trump to Meet Russia’s Putin in Finland on July 16
